title: Add love emoji + balloon screen transition on Yes click

requirements.text: Keep the app behavior and UI the same, except: when the user clicks the existing “Yes! 💕” button on the final slide (“Will You Be My Valentine?”), play a full-screen transition animation featuring floating love emojis and maroon/pink/blue love balloons flying across the screen.

quotes:
Keep every single thing same.
Just When Yes button is clicked on Will you be my valentine? Page Make a screen transition of love emojis and Maroon, pink, blue  love balloon flying

acceptanceCriteria: On the final carousel slide, clicking the “Yes! 💕” button triggers a full-screen overlay animation (screen transition) that includes visible love emojis and balloon-like elements.
The balloon elements use maroon, pink, and blue colors (all three colors must be present in the animation).
During the transition overlay, the underlying UI remains visually unchanged (no layout shifts), and user interaction with underlying elements is blocked until the animation completes.

After the transition finishes, the app proceeds exactly as it did before the change (i.e., it shows the existing “Forever Yours! 💕” accepted state and the existing “Moments💞” CTA, with no other behavior changes).
No other screens (including the Moments page) change their visuals or behavior as a result of this feature.

requirements.text: Implement the transition animation using project styling conventions (Tailwind + existing CSS animation approach) by adding any required new keyframes/utility classes and rendering a React overlay within the existing App component flow.

quotes: Make a screen transition of love emojis and Maroon, pink, blue  love balloon flying

acceptanceCriteria: The animation is implemented in the frontend without adding backend dependencies.
Animation-related styles are added in the existing styling system (e.g., in frontend/src/index.css and/or Tailwind utilities) without modifying any immutable frontend paths.
The overlay is rendered/controlled from the existing Valentine page flow in frontend/src/App.tsx and does not break navigation between carousel and Moments views.

constraints: Do not change any behavior or styling outside the “Yes” click transition on the final “Will You Be My Valentine?” slide.
Backend must remain unchanged (backend/main.mo stays with no new functionality).
Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui or any other immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Adding new pages, new buttons, or changing any copy beyond what is required to support the transition.
Implementing real-time effects, audio, or backend-driven animation state.
